speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Retinitis

I have noted that your vision has decreased and you see black spots in the right eye without pain, while the left eye is asymptomatic. While I see a request to diagnose Tuberculosis, the clinical picture of painless vision loss and floaters in an AIDS patient is most characteristic of CMV retinitis; therefore, I will proceed with that diagnosis based on the evidence.
